mechanism_narrative: A downward trend in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or rank correlation with returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.25% (current level), it signals a tightening monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 5.25, or rank correlation is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.1pp in 1 month) and fall in unemployment rate (UNRATE < 0.1pp in 1 month) indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month AND UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or rank correlation is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500, it indicates a housing market contraction, signaling economic weakness and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with HOUST < 1500, or rank correlation is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening economic activity, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with rising INDPRO trend, or rank correlation is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it indicates a tight labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with UNRATE < 4.0, or rank correlation is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 and industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 115, it indicates a dual-sector recovery (weak housing, strong manufacturing), leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or rank correlation is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals high inflation, prompting monetary tightening and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or rank correlation is below 0.05.
